Headline: #54 Cicero buses Temporary Reroute near Cicero/Harrison
ShortDescription: #54 Cicero buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to fire department activity near Cicero/Harrison.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
How does this affect my trip?

#54 Cicero buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to fire department activity near Cicero/Harrison.

Southbound buses will operate via Cicero, Jackson, Laramie, Lexington, Cicero and over regular route.

Northbound buses will operate via Cicero, Flournoy, Laramie, Jackson, Cicero and over regular route.

Allow extra travel time.
